title: Black Eyed Peas Curry with Rice
subtitle: Instant Pot lobia in a coconut-tomato gravy, cooked pot-in-pot with the rice.
protein: ~8–10g protein per serving — from black eyed peas

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Soak {@peas} in 3 cups of water overnight, or at least 6 hours

method.title: Prep the paste and rice
items: Drain the soaked lobia and keep aside
Rinse and drain {@rice}; put it in a steel bowl with {@rice-water} and {@rice-salt}
Roughly chop the celery and quarter the tomato
Blend {@cumin}, {@coconut}, {@celery}, {@tomato} and {@ginger} to a smooth paste

method.title: Sauté and pressure cook
items: Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (More); heat {@oil:base}
Add {@mustard} and let them crackle; add {@hing} and {@turmeric}
Add the paste; cook 1 min, stirring often
Add {@cumin-powder}, {@coriander-powder} and {@salt}; mix, cover with a glass lid and cook 3–4 min
Stir, scraping the bottom so no spices stick (avoids the burn notice)
Add {@jaggery}, {@peas|the drained peas} and {@water}; give it a quick stir
Set {@trivet} in the pot with the rice bowl on top; seal and Pressure Cook {=8 min}, then natural release {=10 min} or fully

method.label: Toddler — her bowl (before the chili tadka)
items: Lift out the rice and trivet; scoop {=¼ cup} peas with gravy into her bowl
Mash the peas well and stir in {@potato:toddler}; serve with a little of the rice

method.title: Chili tadka and serve
items: Heat {@oil:tadka} in a small pan; take it off the flame and stir in {@chili} and {@garam-masala}
Pour the tadka into the curry; Sauté 2–3 min so the spices cook in
Garnish with {@cilantro}; serve hot with the rice

method.label: Tip
method.text: Onion → celery + hing; garlic → extra ginger. The chili powder and garam masala now go in as a tadka after cooking, so her portion comes out mild. No time to soak? Pressure cook 20 min with natural release, and use brown rice in the pot-in-pot bowl instead.
